independent_reference.source: Rossler, O. E. (1976), 'An equation for continuous chaos', Phys. Lett. A 57 (5), 397-398, Eq. (1) defines the field and the canonical (a, b, c) = (0.2, 0.2, 5.7). The fixed-point coordinates follow from elementary algebra on Eq. (1): y = -z, x = a*z, and a*z^2 - c*z + b = 0 (hand-derivation in the derivation .md section 1). Three independent derivation routes agree: the hand algebra, the SymPy symbolic generator, and the sim-side numerical solve (numpy) exercised by the golden test.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand-derivation of the quadratic fixed-point condition; SymPy generator re-derives symbolically; numpy root cross-check in the sim test
